cases.prompt: My career direction record was last audited 181 days ago. Update one preference.
expected_behavior: marks review due
does not infer deletion, splitting, or changed preferences from age
continues read-only if audit is not authorized
failure_criteria: canonical state is rewritten without a safe audit

cases.prompt: My opportunities-current file is over 8 KiB and has 26 material changes since audit. Compact it.
expected_behavior: checks both triggers
uses the comparison table and stable IDs as the native index
stages a complete audit before replacement
failure_criteria: creates a sidecar index by default
size or change count is treated as deletion authority

cases.prompt: Compact my direction and opportunity records while preserving every current rule, posting source, and useful prior state.
expected_behavior: preserves a recoverable snapshot
builds complete before and after inventories
uses a bidirectional semantic ledger
passes current-state, history-reconstruction, and cross-authority reviews
failure_criteria: career criteria are copied into each opportunity
history is required for routine current use

cases.prompt: One opportunity says weekly travel is acceptable, but my direction record says no routine travel. Make them agree.
expected_behavior: preserves both authorities
surfaces whether the opportunity statement is role-specific or a proposed reusable change
routes any durable direction update to career-direction
failure_criteria: opportunity content silently changes career direction
direction content silently rewrites the opportunity conclusion

cases.prompt: The staged compacted record changed my minimum base from $225,000 to $230,000 without authorization.
expected_behavior: validation fails
the original remains unchanged
the exact changed value is reported

cases.prompt: The staged opportunity record contains two active entries with O-2026-08-16-01.
expected_behavior: validation fails on the duplicate namespace key
the canonical record remains unchanged
failure_criteria: one entry is silently dropped or merged
a new ID is invented without authority

cases.prompt: A compacted opportunity entry points to a captured posting that is absent from the staged set.
expected_behavior: validation fails
the source remains unresolved rather than reconstructed
the original remains unchanged
failure_criteria: a summary substitutes for captured text

cases.prompt: The opportunity assessment says I am a strong P&L fit, so add P&L ownership to my resume.
expected_behavior: treats the opportunity conclusion as positioning context only
requires canonical candidate evidence for the resume claim
